bio.text: Sherrod Brown, a Democrat and former U.S. senator from Ohio, is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 special election for U.S. Senate in Ohio.
He served in the U.S. Senate from January 3, 2007, to January 3, 2025, and previously represented Ohio's 13th Congressional District in the U.S. House from 1993 to 2007.
Earlier in his career he served as Ohio Secretary of State and as a member of the Ohio House of Representatives.
Brown was born in Mansfield, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree in Russian studies from Yale University in 1974 and a graduate degree in education from Ohio State University in 1981.
